properties.notes: Planning permission 15/16255/FUL for 1 net additional home (C3) granted on 14/09/2015. Planning permission 14/10203/FUL for 6 net additional homes (C3) granted on 03/04/2017.. Erection of a two storey rear infill extension at first and second floor levels to facilitate the conversion of a five bedroom split level maisonette into 2 x two-bedroomed flats (C3). Change of use of existing first floor of building from a pool hall (D2) and conversion to create 6 x self-contained flats (C3) (3 x one-bedroom and 3 x-two bedroom).
